newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Chiao Tung on third limit up since debut.
newsitem.headline: Chiao Tung on third limit up since debut.

text.p: Taiwan's state-run Chiao Tung Bank, which debuted on Wednesday, rose the daily seven percent limit for the third straight session on Monday, but brokers said its honeymoon rise may soon end.
With 80 minutes left, Chiao Tung was up T$4 to T$66.5, while the overall index was down 0.02 percent.
Chiao Tung went limit up on Wednesday and Thursday. The market was closed on Friday and Saturday due to holidays.

"Prospects for the state-run industrial bank are quite good, but after rising for three consecutive limit ups, it has neared its grey market price of T$68 before its listing," said Albert Lin of Golden Securities.
"On Tuesday, Chiao Tung probably cannot rise another limit up, and its honeymoon rise is about to end," he said.
